Important Information We recommend doing a patch test before starting any new product on your skin to ensure you don't experience any initial adverse reaction. Follow the following steps for a patch test: 1. Apply the product to a small patch of skin either to the arm or bend of the elbow. 2. Keep the area dry. 3. Leave on for 12-24 hours. 4. If any redness, itching, or irritation is observed at any time during the test, do not use the product Is it right for you? Answers that we believe must be heard. Frequently asked questions About Pigmentation Repair Cream for Women When should I apply this cream? Since this is a leave-in formulation, you can apply the cream on the pigmented areas post your shower in the morning. Keep it as long as possible and wait for the cream to absorb. How much time will it take to see results? You should notice visible reduction in pigmentation with 3 months of use. For severe pigmentation: changes depend on the severity of the condition. We recommend speaking to an expert for your specific case. Is it suitable for sensitive skin? Yes, both products are Paraben, Sulphate & Phthalate-free. However, do a patch test before first use and introduce gradually if you have sensitive skin. Can I use this product on my face? This product is formulated for use on the body and may be too potent for the delicate skin on your face. We recommend using products specifically designed for facial moisturization. How does Lactic Acid help in pigmentation? By exfoliating and boosting cell turnover, Lactic Acid helps fade surface-level pigmentation. It gradually reveals smoother, more uniform-toned skin.
